patch_description: Crossover of the best-performing program (multi-start greedy with diverse orderings and two greedy modes + local search, scoring 26.18) with the current program's best-fit greedy tie-breaking and 3-cycle rotation refinement. The new version builds a pool of candidate placements from multiple sort orders (by weight, by size, by weight-density, etc.) and two greedy modes (post-placement KVPR best-fit with memory tie-break, and lowest-current-KVPR), then applies an efficient incremental local search with single-model moves, pairwise swaps, and 3-cycle rotations across the hottest GPUs, keeping the best result across all candidates.
